about: SCION 14 trace. state = what the drawing on screen shows (classified from the drawing, with a pixel check for when backing stops); x_screen,y_screen = centroid of the dog pixels measured from the render each frame; facing = where the head points (+1 to the door, -1 away); camera fixed.
